stage.description: Five levels across the South African savanna. Get the Big Five in sight, or keep them safe.
level.lion.description: Two routes lead to the Lion Waterhole: quick open ground on the ridge, or the slower riverbed with cover.
level.lion.briefing.attacker: Explorer, the lions gather at the waterhole in the late afternoon. Get a team into the zone and hold it long enough for the sighting. The Ridge Route is quick but exposed; the Riverbed Route gives cover but slows you down. One strong wave usually gets further than many small ones.
level.lion.briefing.defender: Ranger, an expedition wants a close sighting at the Lion Waterhole. Keep them out of the zone until the timer runs out or their capacity is used up. Posts spot groups early, checkpoints hold them up, and a patrol at the waterhole stops their hold timer. Remember: you may never close every route.
tutorial.lion.attacker.welcome: Welcome, Explorer! Your goal is the Lion Waterhole. Get a group into the zone and hold it until the bar is full.
tutorial.lion.attacker.routes: Two routes lead there. The Ridge Route crosses open ground: fast, but easy to spot. The Riverbed Route has cover: slower, but safer.
tutorial.lion.attacker.prep: Right now it is preparation time. The Ranger is building defenses you cannot see yet. Use it to plan your first wave.
tutorial.lion.attacker.launch: Build a wave: pick a unit, set how many, choose a formation and a route (click a route on the map or use the buttons). Press Launch once preparation is over.
tutorial.lion.attacker.spotted: Your group is on its way. When it sees a Ranger structure, the structure stays marked on your map, even after you lose sight of it.
tutorial.lion.attacker.select: Click your group on the map or in the group list to give it orders.
tutorial.lion.attacker.orders: Groups can hold at the next junction, reroute, advance or retreat. Try Hold now; press Advance to move on again.
tutorial.lion.attacker.recon: Reconnaissance reveals defenses in an area for a while. Choose it, then click a spot on the map.
tutorial.lion.attacker.objective: Now get into the waterhole zone. A ranger patrol standing in the zone stops your hold timer, so send enough people.
tutorial.lion.attacker.done: That is everything you need. Keep sending waves until you hold the waterhole. Good luck out there!
tutorial.lion.defender.welcome: Welcome, Ranger! Keep the Explorers from holding the Lion Waterhole until the timer runs out or they have no capacity left.
tutorial.lion.defender.routes: Explorers come along the Ridge Route or the Riverbed Route. You only see their groups once a post or a patrol detects them.
tutorial.lion.defender.post: Build an Observation Post: choose it in the build bar, then click a glowing build site on the map.
tutorial.lion.defender.checkpoint: A Temporary Checkpoint on a route point blocks the way until the group wears it down. You can never block every route. Place one now.
tutorial.lion.defender.patrol: Ranger Patrols walk the routes and press groups they meet. A patrol in the waterhole zone stops the hold timer. Place one.
tutorial.lion.defender.combat: When preparation ends, the Explorers start sending waves. Watch the timer at the top.
tutorial.lion.defender.spotted: Wait for a group to be detected. It appears on your map as soon as one of your assets spots it.
tutorial.lion.defender.intercept: Intercept slows one detected group. Choose it, then click a group on the map.
tutorial.lion.defender.select: Click one of your assets on the map or in the list to see its orders.
tutorial.lion.defender.upgrade: Upgrade it: it reaches further and presses harder. Repair brings back a worn checkpoint; Sell returns half the cost.
tutorial.lion.defender.done: That is everything you need. Hold out until the timer runs out. Good luck out there!
unit.scout.description: Fast and light. Sees defenses from far away, but turns back quickly.
unit.guide.description: Knows the trails: Concealed, with a long view ahead.
unit.expedition-team.description: The backbone of a wave: steady and hard to turn back.
unit.expedition-vehicle.description: Fast on any track and very hard to turn back, but easy to spot and uses a lot of capacity.
unit.tracker.description: Reads the ground and spots defenses early.
unit.hunter-team.description: Tough and well equipped: takes apart barriers and equipment it works on.
unit.breach-specialist.description: Slow, but takes barriers, fences and sensors apart in moments. Never people or animals.
unit.offroad-vehicle.description: Pushes through roadblocks: fast, very tough and good at clearing barriers.
unit.observer.description: Stealth: almost invisible unless a sensor or a reveal finds it. Fragile.
unit.camera-team.description: Concealed and patient: wins time at the objective much faster than anyone else.
unit.spotter.description: Concealed, with the longest view of all: finds defenses before they find you.
unit.utility-vehicle.description: Brings a team to the objective quickly, but anyone can see it coming.
defense.observation-post.description: Sees far across open ground and turns back groups in reach.
defense.temporary-checkpoint.description: On a route node it stops groups until they push through. Slows and turns back strongly.
defense.ranger-patrol.description: Walks the routes, guards a place or patrols between two. Contests the objective.
defense.tracker-team.description: A mobile sensor: finds Concealed and Stealth groups as easily as any other.
defense.response-vehicle.description: The fastest asset on the map: gets to a threatened route in time.
defense.senior-ranger.description: Experienced rangers: turn groups back faster than anyone.
defense.light-barrier.description: A cheap roadblock on a route node. Attacker units can take it apart.
defense.patrol-beacon.description: A sensor post: finds Concealed and Stealth groups nearby.
defense.protection-tower.description: Strong reach and steady pressure from a build zone.
defense.heavy-barrier.description: A roadblock that holds for a long time. It cannot be dismantled, only worn down.
defense.conservation-post.description: Slows groups in reach and turns them back gently.
defense.observation-platform.description: Sees further than any other structure. It cannot be sabotaged.
defense.slow-field.description: Soft ground and brush markers: groups in reach move much slower.
defense.warning-barrier.description: A very cheap roadblock that wears quickly: buys a few seconds.
defense.temporary-fence.description: A roadblock that is taken down again after 45 seconds.
defense.environmental-marker.description: Cheap markers that make groups nearby easier to see and a little slower.
defense.protection-team.description: A patrol that presses hard where it stands.
defense.maintenance-crew.description: Repairs worn barriers and structures in reach while it stands by.
defense.relocation-unit.description: Calmly guides the animals away from visitors: slows groups near it and contests the objective.
defense.sensor-beacon.description: Cheap and anywhere: finds Concealed and Stealth groups passing by.
defense.observation-station.description: A research station that sees far, finds hidden groups and turns back those in reach.
defense.research-team.description: A patrol of researchers: identifies groups and slows them a little.
defense.surveillance-drone.description: Flies fast between places and finds hidden groups from above.
ability.field-guide.name: Field Guide
ability.field-guide.description: Along one route: defenses are revealed and your groups move faster.
ability.sabotage.name: Sabotage
ability.sabotage.description: Puts equipment in a small area out of action for a while (teams of people keep working). A group must be close by.
ability.breach.name: Breach
ability.breach.description: Opens a roadblock at a route node: barriers are taken apart and the rest stops working for a moment.
ability.coordinated-assault.name: Coordinated Assault
ability.coordinated-assault.description: All your groups move faster and take less pressure for a short time.
ability.concealed-approach.name: Concealed Approach
ability.concealed-approach.description: Your groups on one route are much harder to detect for a while.
ability.perfect-position.name: Perfect Position
ability.perfect-position.description: Groups at the objective win hold time much faster for a while.
ability.snapshot-window.name: Snapshot Window
ability.snapshot-window.description: For a short window your groups at the objective take far less pressure.
ability.emergency-reinforcement.name: Emergency Reinforcement
ability.emergency-reinforcement.descript: A ranger patrol arrives at a route node and stays for 30 seconds.
ability.conservation-barrier.name: Conservation Barrier
ability.conservation-barrier.description: Puts up a temporary fence on a route node at once.
ability.protected-zone.name: Protected Zone
ability.protected-zone.description: In an area groups are slowed and your structures resist wear and sabotage.
ability.habitat-lockdown.name: Habitat Lockdown
ability.habitat-lockdown.description: Closes a route node for 12 seconds. At least one route always stays open.
ability.area-scan.name: Area Scan
ability.area-scan.description: Reveals every group in a large area for a while, hidden ones too.
ability.route-analysis.name: Route Analysis
ability.route-analysis.description: Every group on one route is revealed and slowed for a while.
ability.deep-analysis.name: Deep Analysis
ability.deep-analysis.description: Pins one detected group in place for a few seconds and keeps it revealed.
